content.title: Implement: write user-friendly markdown documentation
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

You now have access to the docs/ folder. This is a retry of mpdpuhd0r5 which failed due to access restrictions.

Your task (AC2 + AC3 from the spec):

Part 1 - Remove old docs:
Delete all existing contents of the docs/ directory:
- Delete docs/html/ directory (TypeDoc HTML output)
- Delete docs/md/ directory (TypeDoc Markdown output)
- Delete docs/introduction.md
- Delete docs/hierarchy.md
- Delete docs/commands.md
- Delete docs/issue-blockages.md
- Delete docs/user-auth.md
- The docs/ directory should contain only the new markdown/ subdirectory after cleanup

Part 2 - Write 8 new markdown files in docs/markdown/:
1. overview.md - introduction, key features, quick example
2. getting-started.md - install, init, first session (CLI + JS)
3. authentication.md - auth modes, tokens, user management
4. issue-object.md - properties, computed fields, status lifecycle, event sourcing
5. hierarchy-and-blockages.md - parent-child, status constraints, auto-promotion, blockages, cycle detection
6. storing-issues-in-git.md - .agentrack/ structure, orphan branch, push/pull
7. cli-reference.md - all agt commands with syntax, flags, examples
8. javascript-reference.md - Tracker class methods, exported types, examples

Writing guidelines:
- Audience: developers and AI agent operators, NOT library contributors
- Tone: clear, concise, practical
- Always show both CLI and JavaScript examples where applicable
- Cross-reference between doc files using relative links
- Standard markdown, no Docusaurus-specific syntax
- Each file should be over 100 lines with non-trivial content
- The CLI reference must document ALL commands listed in the spec
- The JS reference must document ONLY public exports, NOT internal modules

The spec contains detailed content outlines for each section. Read the existing docs files (introduction.md, hierarchy.md, commands.md, issue-blockages.md, user-auth.md) BEFORE deleting them — they contain accurate reference content that should be restructured into the new format.

Also read packages/library/src/index.ts to understand the public API surface for the JavaScript reference.

content.content:
This replaces mpdpuhd0r5 which failed because library-release lacked docs/ folder access. Access has now been granted by the user.

Context for content writing: The library exports a Tracker class with methods: init, create, update, list, view, history, next, addComment, updateComment, deleteComment, listComments, addBlockage, resolveBlockage, deleteBlockage, listBlockages, registerUser, listUsers, revokeUser, regenerateToken, push, pull. Exported types include IssueProperties, ComputedIssue, IssueStatus, CreateIssueOptions, UpdateIssueOptions, ListFilters, NextResult, AgentrackError, and various event and blockage and user types. CLI command is agt. Status flow: idea then todo then in-progress then done then closed. Auth modes: open, read-only, strict. Issues stored on orphan git branch _agentrack via worktree.

IMPORTANT: Read the existing docs files in docs/ BEFORE deleting them. They contain accurate reference content (CLI commands, auth modes, hierarchy rules, blockage lifecycle) that should be restructured into the new format rather than written from scratch.

Done. Wrote 8 user-friendly markdown documentation files in docs/markdown/ and deleted all old docs content.

Part 1 - Old docs deleted:
- docs/html/ (TypeDoc HTML output)
- docs/md/ (TypeDoc Markdown output)
- docs/introduction.md
- docs/hierarchy.md
- docs/commands.md
- docs/issue-blockages.md
- docs/user-auth.md

Part 2 - 8 new files created in docs/markdown/:
- overview.md (116 lines) - intro, features, quick example, status lifecycle
- getting-started.md (229 lines) - install, init, first session (CLI + JS)
- authentication.md (228 lines) - auth modes, tokens, user management
- issue-object.md (199 lines) - properties, computed fields, status lifecycle, event sourcing
- hierarchy-and-blockages.md (343 lines) - parent-child, status constraints, blockages, cycle detection
- storing-issues-in-git.md (238 lines) - .agentrack/ structure, orphan branch, push/pull
- cli-reference.md (813 lines) - all 21 agt commands with syntax, flags, examples, error codes
- javascript-reference.md (714 lines) - Tracker class methods, worktree functions, exported types

All files exceed 100 lines. Cross-references between docs use relative links. Quality gates (typecheck, lint, 649 tests) pass. Total: 2880 lines of documentation.
